points.description: States TRUE (the parent can call exec after forking, before the child terminates).
points.partial_credit: No part marks; the verdict must be TRUE.

points.description: Justification: parent and child are two separate/independent processes, so the parent is free to perform any operation, including exec, regardless of the child (exec in the parent replaces only the parent's image).
points.partial_credit: Half if the justification is vague (e.g. 'they are independent') without saying the parent can still run exec or any operation.

rubric.notes: Full marks need TRUE plus a correct justification that parent and child are separate processes so the parent can still call exec. Per the question, a TRUE answer with no or wrong justification gets 0 overall; do not award P1 alone. A FALSE answer earns 0. Half marks for TRUE with a vague but not wrong justification.
